scope: six distinct historical persons; not all official variants or complete roster

plans.name: 荀彧
plans.identity: Xun Yu 荀彧. A dignified mature civil counsellor, slim and upright, gently elongated oval face with high forehead, narrow thoughtful eyes, neat fine moustache and a short tidy pointed chin beard, calm courteous expression. Distinctive tall RECTANGULAR black woven scholar crown with two restrained horizontal gold ribs, no feather fan and no large round yin-yang badge. Ivory silk formal robe over deep jade-green inner layers, narrow patterned gold edging, orderly long sleeves, small jade waist pendant. Hold a rolled cream silk memorandum tied with a red cord in one hand, a small flat wooden writing tablet in the other, both entirely visible. Modest authoritative scholar silhouette; not Zhuge Liang's face, cap or fan.

plans.name: 郭嘉
plans.identity: Guo Jia 郭嘉. A youthful slender adult strategist, clean-shaven, pale narrow diamond face and pointed chin, intelligent relaxed half-smile, long fine eyebrows, lively almond eyes. Loose swept black side fringe and a LOW asymmetrical dark indigo scholar cap with a single ivory jade pin, absolutely no tall official crown. Smoky indigo and ivory robes with small jade clasps and restrained warm gold cloud embroidery, a light short ivory shoulder wrap, slim waist. One hand holds a small CLOSED bamboo fan at his chest; other hand rests against a compact scroll case at hip. An easy slightly tilted poised stance. Clearly younger, slimmer and more playful than mature bearded Xun Yu or Zhuge Liang. No beard, no white feather fan, no plague/sickness effects.

plans.name: 张辽
plans.identity: Zhang Liao 张辽. A disciplined lean athletic commander with an elongated angular face, firm cheekbones, narrow focused brown eyes, straight severe brows, a close thin moustache and short precise dark chin beard. Upright alert stance, not bulky. Distinctive blue-steel helmet with low swept cheek guards and one short dark teal plume; no long twin feathers. Fine layered blue-steel lamellar armour, ivory under-sleeves, jade sash, modest warm brass-gold edging, a short dark teal commander cloak. Hold a long single crescent-bladed polearm vertically beside the body with BOTH ends fully visible and plenty of margins; opposite hand near belt. The polearm shaft is straight and continuous. No horse, no shield, no elemental marks.

plans.name: 典韦
plans.identity: Dian Wei 典韦. A massively broad square-headed adult warrior, shaved forehead and a small low black topknot, wide blunt nose, dark stubble on jaw, heavy horizontal eyebrows, narrow determined eyes, stern CLOSED mouth. Huge shoulders and thick powerful forearms, squat wide balanced stance; proportion is compact adult chibi, not Zhang Fei's beard or laughing face. Dark iron lamellar armour with heavy ochre leather straps, broad warm brass cloud-edged shoulder guards, ivory cloth lower layers, small jade belt fittings. Wields TWO short matching iron halberds, one in each hand, held down and outward so all curved hooks, spear points and both handles are fully visible. No shield, no long spear, no flowing bushy beard, no copied tiger face identity.

plans.name: 许褚
plans.identity: Xu Chu 许褚. A huge barrel-bodied muscular adult guard with a broad ROUND face, full cheeks, strong rounded chin, thick neck, warm tan skin, thick arched brows and direct friendly-but-fierce eyes, completely clean-shaven. Very short coarse black hair under a simple bronze-gold headband, NO topknot and NO helmet. Round-bodied bear-like solidity, visibly different from square-faced shaven-front Dian Wei and bushy-bearded Zhang Fei. Warm bronze and dark leather armour with one stylized rounded tiger-face shoulder plate, jade belt knot and ivory trousers, broad boots. Carries ONE heavy broad straight-backed dao sword, blade angled downward on the open side, entire blade and hilt visible; other hand clenched at waist. No shield, no dual weapons, no fan.

plans.name: 夏侯渊
plans.identity: Xiahou Yuan 夏侯渊. A seasoned lean adult commander with a rectangular weathered tan face, short wedge-shaped dark beard with two subtle grey streaks near temples, slightly asymmetrical alert eyebrows, sharp cheerful determined eyes, BOTH EYES intact and visible, no eyepatch. Low ridged brushed-steel helmet with a short jade-green trailing cloth knot, distinct from Cao Cao's tall crown. Fast-moving commander posture with one boot slightly forward but fully grounded. Slate steel and warm tan leather lamellar armour, ivory sleeves, jade sash, short practical cream cloak. Holds a recurved polished dark wooden BOW low across one side, a compact quiver of arrows visible over the other shoulder; full upper and lower bow tips and continuous bowstring remain inside the canvas. No horse, no firearm, no elemental symbol. This is an individual historical commander with a bow, not an archer troop category.
